<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Supreme Court refers ECI law to Constitution Bench:</strong> Following a split verdict, the Supreme Court has referred petitions challenging the 2023 law governing the appointment of Election Commissioners to a five-judge Constitution Bench, with some judges raising concerns over executive dominance.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxQQXM2SHN5MjBqOE1XaWQ0UG5HWEktM1VfQzEtWGU4b0lGVkdGc0VKc09uRlVvZFViNGdpU1ZyWVdXUFRsMVdsZ0F3SDZxbEw1Q0NkMHBEai1SdGtLM3pwUnlKb1hWWmFOckZFTXhWZXZFdHVBb3FZeEdnUnNzSWowQXVIUzZnS1lCS2pEY25uaw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxOall0Wm9WN25zMlpXMjNXcVBsMXk3M1pnTVR3Y0ZYQy1DWXhYY2lMTFR1ZVBVb3BKN19PcTVGYVo0UTd6R0FxZnRJcXFsOVc2cE1XTHdWLVdZc3ZSekRuNDVDemxER0V2WmRXbmVHbmhkVWpHNGo0RE00bkpDWmRoMFBfU3AzREt4bDRLb0J2cmgxcVhpYjE1WUhHdHExWVY4cktYMElQQnhUekhvMWFNazRyYjl5V05ZMS1sM21GLWFrUHdrR2I0?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political fallout over ECI internal reports:</strong> Reports of internal objections by Election Commissioners regarding poll panel decisions have triggered a sharp political face-off, with the Opposition demanding the CEC&#x27;s impeachment while the BJP defends the Commission&#x27;s integrity.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I31</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I34</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I41</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I43</a> <a href="https://news.google._?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I48</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>SC flags delay in disqualification pleas:</strong> The Supreme Court has labeled the Lok Sabha Speaker’s three-month delay in addressing disqualification petitions against rebel Trinamool Congress MPs as a &quot;red flag.&quot;<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I38</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxPN1BOSFp2MzZHUlFTU2VGeU50aFY2bU0zVzdTbXNKbk1POFBVbzFHbWI0bW1Ba1hRSHRJTE82WXFhWlpMZmtpa0hrSjdiOEdNZGFkMExzLWU3ai1LeTRRc0QtVS1TOGNGODRLcGJsclBIZi1vNU4xR25temdaa004all0b0ZtU0JRbDNjZEZLbGFfZ3JiUjNRbTRqLUc3NnloRkxKZERCTW44N3dyTHF0Uk1LaXVKZk9QcFJz?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I39</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I40</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>BJP defends ECI against opposition allegations:</strong> The BJP has rejected claims of internal disquiet within the Election Commission, asserting that differing views among commissioners are a sign of a vibrant democracy and challenging the opposition to pursue formal impeachment if they have evidence of wrongdoing.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W14</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>PM Modi to chair Cabinet Chintan Shivir:</strong> Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to preside over a two-day &#x27;Chintan Shivir&#x27; starting Wednesday, where Cabinet ministers will present updates and deliberate on key policy initiatives.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxPY2ZSZ0JSNlFXY0ptVGE5RWhGWjlJd3JLRVZZVXZlakQ1TkFHVXdNVmlMSDF6Wmt4YW4wY3lCME1UbmRPSEYtOGJmVHdfSms1WTJHYmpUMmZ0RVpVSHFGZV9jVVh4RFRNRmZ5WXdnLWd1WFBTMjhpUk1mOWZDaGdINXcyUDJFM3hub1VsdVlXNTNYNnpEM2lfMGVlQmJaQkt3Z183dXYzT1htYnE1b19nRXkyeUs4MFgx?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxPdTZlSk5EMTB3dXVQenNOUFA3QjBLbkh1dkFCOFdGR0tGUWU0eE9VWGQ3LXNMcHJZYUhhMFd2ZTJfd0Nnblc4MFhUaWZqZmVQRFhUdGVZY29pSjZUbkpJWnUyODVRMmFJaUhaa3h2RWJQMEt2ODBLdWtLZTA1aTBXS3UzNGp1dGZ5SWdrMkZ0SDVMNzNYYUN1aXQzNHJBQQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxOZ1FHT2dKazAwSzVEZDNpYXFMQmlxRWFLeDZhcl9EZ2E4MTNvYzVsdndDRWlIODl5dl8tRDBRMHFVN3pPUnhnTVhYTmlUUU50d2NwVXNoVzkxc0psSElWM1BEZmJLU1N6bmhaemJ0MTFkSm1PWTZGWDZ0TzlwLXNhaHlveE1yZUE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a></span></li>
